author: Elijah Jero
name: CMLink
description: Tournament integration with Challenger Mode. Monitors tournaments, creates Discord channels for matches, manages tournament participants, and provides real-time updates on tournament progress.
install_msg: CMLink cog loaded. Set your Challenger Mode refresh token with `[p]cmlink settings setrefreshtoken`, then configure tournament channels with `[p]cmlink tournament settings`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs linked to Challenger Mode accounts, guild tournament settings, and API credentials. It contacts the Challenger Mode API.
